name: Save stops on a profile switch
step: Check that a profile page's Save stops when the profile switches
rationale:
Issue #2809: the FC writes MSP_SET_PID_PROFILE and MSP_SET_GOVERNOR_PROFILE into
whichever PID profile is active when each arrives, and the governor write carries the whole
governor profile. Tail Rotor saves both, so a PID profile switch between them replaced the other
profile's governor settings and committed them. app/page_runtime.lua now asks MSP_STATUS for the
active profile before each write of a page whose profileField is pidProfile or rateProfile, and
stops unsent when it is not the profile the page read (or, without a telemetry profile, the FC's
first answer). Each such write leaves the MSP queue once and is resent only after the check again.

The harness drives the real Tail Rotor page through the real page_runtime and codecs against a
mocked FC with one record per profile, and pins the request order, a switch before and between the
writes, telemetry showing the switch, a lost reply with and without a switch, bounded resends, a
failed status request, no telemetry profile, and that a profileField "none" page is not checked.
